title: Hands-On Check
description: The in-person sign-off that ends the Greens Storage Academy new-hire plan: a mock sales call scored on The Call Score Sheet, a guided site walk and a supervised move-in in Cubby. There is no quiz.
overview: A mock sales call, scored on the same sheet and the same 70% pass mark as the Customer Service course
A guided site walk: the lock check, a vacant unit check and a vehicle lot walk
A supervised move-in in Cubby with a test or real tenant
What happens if a part is not ready yet: you redo it later, nothing to fail
